findings.reason: adding `s34` to §14's declared waits is a one-token edit that keeps the drain from being launched on the broken measure §34 exists to repair; without it the plan's closing measure runs on a landing pass that refuses every armed run.
findings.text: §14's `plan-section-depends-on` lists every implementable section (§13, §15, §18–§33) but not `s34`, which the same edit added as `implementable`; §14's own first sentence says the drain begins "Once every other section has landed", and the queue orders only what the plan declares, so the dogfood drain can be dispatched before the pass that makes its landing measurement run has landed. The build-order followup beside §14 ("§14, the dogfood week, last") also does not name §34.

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `landing_measure.measure_run` (`reckon/crew/landing_measure.py:300`), `base_checkout` (`:473`), the `landing-measure/` log directory (`reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:145`) and the `{node_test_files}` placeholder (`reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:332`) all resolve as cited.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §34's done-when carries four falsifiable bullets over a real subprocess runner, and its declared negative control (restore the raw `shlex` argv) makes the first arm fail; each of the other three bullets also fails when its own fix is removed (no `.venv` link, no test-file copy, no environment on the population arm).
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the gate log and test live under the repository's own paths, and the coordinator arm records into the plan's landing record at `docs/evidence/archive/a-queue-holds-the-whole-plan-landed.html`, the anchor every landing beat on this plan uses.
rubric_items.naming: pass — `tests/test_the_landing_measure_runs_the_armed_command.py` and `landing_measure.py` name the mechanism; no plan, stage or ticket label reaches a symbol, path or comment.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — I reproduced the stated root cause before scoring it: `shlex.split("PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q {node_test_files}")[0]` is `'PYTHONPATH=.'`, `_arm` records `exit_status=None`, `readable` is False, and the log line is byte-identical to the one §34 quotes (`FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'PYTHONPATH=.'`). Cause 2 holds: `_measure_delivery` reads `pointer["suite_command"]`, which `dispatch.py:2696` stores as the declaration *as written* while the resolved spelling sits in the separate `suite_command_resolved`. Cause 3 holds: `base_checkout` builds a bare `git worktree add --detach` tree (`:500`) with a gitignored `.venv` absent. The mechanism reaches the done-when because every arm — suite, population and isolated — routes through `_arm` (`:259`), and the production caller is `queue_landing._measure_delivery` → `measure_run` (`reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:152`) on the landing pass.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §34 has one deliverable, a measurement that runs and returns comparable arms, and all four bullets close on that one verdict.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — the plan's `plan-section-depends-on` gives §14 every implementable section except `s34`, although §14's own first sentence requires that every other section has landed before the drain begins.
